passages.text: A full bathroom renovation means stripping to the walls, new waterproofing, plumbing and electrics, tiles on walls and floor, and new sanitaryware. Labour is usually about half of the final price; mid-range tiles and fittings make up most of the rest.

In my Sofia jobs a full bathroom takes two to three weeks. Moving the shower or the toilet adds roughly EUR 600 to 900 for new drains, and a walk-in shower with glass costs about EUR 400 more than a bathtub.
